verdict.rationale: Plaid hosts an official remote Dashboard MCP server, so users can operate parts of the product through natural language in an AI client. Its documented scope is limited to Production diagnostics and analytics: debugging Items, reviewing Link conversion data and checking usage metrics. Core API operations such as pulling transactions or initiating payments are not documented as reachable this way. missing for 10: natural-language control beyond diagnostics/analytics (e.g., core API actions), documentation of the conversational workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
